- Wait for scientific consensus

One reason for this position is that assessments without an agreed-upon construct do not measure anything stable. In a 2026 comparison, five published welfare-assessment protocols applied to the same model agreed on only 3 out of 20 indicators, highlighting the lack of consistency and reliability in current methods. Therefore, waiting for scientific consensus ensures that any assessments are based on robust and validated methodologies.

This approach helps ensure that AI systems are designed and deployed in a responsible manner, minimizing the risk of unintended negative consequences.
